excerpts: SCORE 7 [Arizona Cardinals 3-8](https://www.nfl.com/teams/arizona-cardinals) SCORE 34 [Kansas City Chiefs 8-2](https://www.nfl.com/teams/kansas-city-chiefs) **REWATCH:** [Cardinals-Chiefs on NFL+ Premium](https://www.nfl.com/plus/replays/2026/reg11/?campaign=nfl-nfl-ca-it-nu-3007807) [FULL BOX SCORE](https://www.nfl.com/games/cardinals-at-chiefs-2026-reg-11) ... **Chiefs handle business in blowout win over Cardinals.** [Patrick Mahomes](https://www.nfl.com/players/patrick-mahomes) diced up Arizona’s defense with T-1000 precision. Before sitting for the bulk of the fourth quarter, the star QB racked up 324 yards on 27-of-39 passing with three touchdowns. It marked the second straight game for Mahomes breaking the 300-yard barrier and the third time in four weeks.

It was vintage Kelce on [a stick-nod 22-yard TD snag](https://www.nfl.com/videos/can-t-miss-play-mahomes-second-td-connection-with-kelce-is-delivered-amid-swarm-of-cardinals) to blast the game open late in the second quarter. ... Everything was clicking as the Chiefs scored on their first five drives and racked up 435 yards and 27 first downs against the hapless Cards. Rolling over struggling opponents is exactly what good teams do. Much like the Bills, K.C. wasn’t looking ahead to Thanksgiving night, and got a little more rest in the fourth quarter for its efforts.

recap.paragraph: The final score lit up Kansas City: Chiefs 34, Cardinals 7. Patrick Mahomes zipped a touchdown pass to Travis Kelce to start the scoring! Emmett Johnson rumbled in for another Chiefs touchdown. Arizona answered when Josh Johnson found Simi Fehoko for a touchdown. Mahomes hit Kelce again, then found Xavier Worthy for his third touchdown pass! The Chiefs put on a spectacular show for their third straight win. Kansas City climbed to 8-2, while Arizona moved to 3-8.
